title: Finite bounded local algebraic models imply controlled cohomology
statement: Let $X,B,R,\phi,C,K,V,a,b$ and the local homology model predicate be as defined in [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-local-homology-models]. Suppose $B$ is a finite commutative ring and the actual constant module functor preserves zero morphisms. If the predicate holds for $K$, then $H^q(K)|_V=0$ for every $q<a$ or $b<q$. Moreover, for each $q$ and each etale $W\to V$, there is a covering sieve on $W$ on whose charts $Z$ the restriction $H^q(K)|_Z$ is isomorphic to $C(N)|_Z$ for some finitely generated $B$-module $N$.

source.place: Tags 094H and 094I: finite algebraic homology and descent of the cohomological bounds.

proof.text: For an algebraic model P, finite generation over the finite ring makes each term a finite set. Its cycles inject into its degree-q term, and homology is a quotient of the cycles. Thus algebraic homology is a finite set and hence a finitely generated B-module.
Outside the support, the degree-q term and hence its homology are zero. Apply the additive realization and slice restriction, and use the model isomorphism to obtain zero on each chart.

Push the etale covering sieve forward to the pro-etale site. Over any object of the slice over V, pull back this sieve. Each covering arrow factors through a zero chart; evaluating that zero restriction makes the section vanish. Sheaf separatedness now implies global slice vanishing. For the local finite model take N to be the finite algebraic homology established above.

theorem finiteCoefficient_local_homology_models
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    {R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1}}
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{t + 1}
      ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X) (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)))
    (V : X.Etale) (a b : ℤ)
    (h : FiniteCoefficientLocalHomologyModels X B φ K V a b) :
    (∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj V)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))) ∧
    DerivedCategory.homologyProperty
      (fun F ↦ ∀ (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj F ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor _ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((finiteCoefficientConstantFunctor X B φ).obj N))) K
